comment: The fleet model chain's ONE source (issue #1140; local tier #1192; provider `nous` #1203). ORDER IS THE CONTRACT: exactly one role=primary first, one or more role=fallback entries in list order, an optional credential-less role=local_fallback tier after the free steps and before the paid pin (issue #1192), exactly one role=last_resort LAST. `make agent-profile-model-render` renders every lane's profile config from this file; `make agent-model-chain-check` refuses drift. The provider is the built-in `nous` provider — the Nous Portal session, the same https://inference-api.nousresearch.com/v1 endpoint — so the remote steps carry NO base_url/key_env (measured #1203: adding them re-routes the alias to `custom` and answers HTTP 401 on inference). A credential is a NAME only (AGENTS.md rule 3e): `key_env`, never a value; the local tier carries none — its box needs none.

measured.how: GET /v1/models with the credential passed by NAME in the environment (refreshed 2026-11-25T09:26:37Z): 3 models carrying the `:free` pricing suffix, every free `model` id below present in that payload with the `context_length` quoted below.
